{"id": "mm7223a3",
 "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of April 2023, two thirds (approximately 66.0%) of mpox vaccine–eligible persons remained unvaccinated."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Shortfall was defined as the percentage of the vaccine-eligible population that did not receive the vaccine"}]},
 "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an estimated 34.0% of the eligible population had received a first dose"}]}],
 "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of April 2023, two thirds (approximately 66.0%) of mpox vaccine–eligible persons remained unvaccinated."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The first dose coverage shortfall was larger among Black (77.9%) and AI/AN (74.5%) persons than among White (66.6%)"}]}],
 "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were obtained from case surveillance reports submitted to CDC by 49 states"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The largest overall mpox vaccination shortfall reductions were achieved from July to August (17.7%) and August to September (8.5%)."}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was used to quantify progress in mpox vaccination overall and by racial and ethnic groups"}]}],
 "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "monthly percent reductions in shortfall were also calculated compared with the preceding month’s shortfall"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The size of the eligible population was calculated as 125% of the sum of the estimated number of MSM with HIV"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Monthly reductions in shortfall were calculated as percent decrease in shortfall compared with the preceding month."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Analyses were conducted using R statistical software (version 4.2.1; R Foundation)."}],
 "confidence": "medium",
 "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
